idea-plugin.name: Lunos
idea-plugin.description:
Lunos, the EU-sovereign, self-hostable AI coding agent, inside IntelliJ IDEA, Rider and the other IntelliJ-based IDEs.

  • A chat panel with a session picker, the model and the approval mode.
  • Right-click Ask Lunos about Selection: the open file and selected lines go with the prompt.
  • Lunos's edits open in the IDE's diff viewer; accept or reject each hunk.
  • Send the file's problems (inspections) as context.
  • The same sessions as the Lunos TUI: open the TUI in the IDE's terminal on the same session, and answer approvals in either.
  • Subagents and their state, e.g. with Dynamic workflows on.

Needs the Lunos CLI (npm i -g lunos-ai). Lunos is not affiliated with JetBrains.

action.description: Ask Lunos with the selected lines and the open file as context
